description: This Java source file defines an Android Fragment class that demonstrates toggling immersive UI modes, including manipulating system UI flags such as fullscreen, hide navigation, and immersive modes through checkbox controls and preset buttons.

classes.name: AdvancedImmersiveModeFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that provides UI controls to toggle immersive mode flags, demonstrating how to programmatically modify system UI visibility for immersive user experiences.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, setting options menu presence.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, initializes checkbox and button controls, and sets up click listeners for preset immersive mode configurations.

methods.name: dumpFlagStateToLog
methods.description: Logs the current state of various system UI flags.

methods.name: toggleUiFlags
methods.description: Toggles system UI flags based on checkbox states to enable or disable immersive, fullscreen, hide navigation, and low profile modes.
